prompt: A teammate opened a PR adding a new `notifications` feature module to `server/`. The three files are in `evals/files/eval-1-notifications/` (routes.ts, service.ts, repository.ts). Review it for backend layering / architecture problems before we merge. List each problem, the ring rule it breaks, and how to fix it.
assertions: Flags that service.ts performs database access directly (imports db/client and db/schema, builds Drizzle queries) instead of delegating to the repository
Flags that NotificationsService takes `Container` as a constructor parameter instead of the specific ports it needs
Flags that routes.ts imports and calls NotificationsRepository directly, bypassing the service layer
Does not invent violations that are not present (no more than one clearly-wrong extra finding)
For each real finding, names the correct fix (move persistence into the repository; inject ports; route through the service)
